Variabe History VIs

Owning Palette: Variable Manager

VIs to configure, read and write variable history.

 

Palette Object Description
VHistory - Get 1D Array of CDB History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the 1D Array of CDB data type.
VHistory - Get 1D Array of DBL History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the 1D Array of DBL data type.
VHistory - Get 1D Array of STR History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the 1D Array of Strings data type.
VHistory - Get 2D Array of CDB History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the 2D Array of CDB data type.
VHistory - Get 2D Array of DBL History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the 2D Array of DBL data type.
VHistory - Get 2D Array of STR History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the 2D Array of Strings data type.
VHistory - Get Arbitrary Variable History.vi Returns the history of a variable of an arbitrary data type; both predefined and user-defined data types are supported.
VHistory - Get CDB Scalar History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the CDB Number data type.
VHistory - Get DBL Scalar History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the DBL Number data type.
VHistory - Get STR History.vi Returns the history of a variable of the String data type.
VHistory - History Controller.vi Controls and monitors the status of variable histories.
VHistory - History Info.vi Returns information about a variable history. The VI does not return an error if the specified variable does not have a history attached.
VHistory - Preset CDB Scalar History.vi Presets the history of a variable of the CDB Number data type. It can either set new history data or append new data to the existing history. This VI sorts timestamps, history values, and writer IDs in ascending chronological order before it presets them to the history; however, the VI does not sort the history after appending the new data.
VHistory - Preset DBL Scalar History.vi Presets the history of a variable of the DBL Number data type. It can either set new history data or append new data to the existing history. This VI sorts timestamps, history values, and writer IDs in ascending chronological order before it presets them to the history; however, the VI does not sort the history after appending the new data.
VHistory - Preset STR History.vi Presets the history of a variable of the String data type. It can either set new history data or append new data to the existing history. This VI sorts timestamps, history values, and writer IDs in ascending chronological order before it presets them to the history; however, the VI does not sort the history after appending the new data.
